split_rule: Fit only releases dated 2020–2022, validate on 2023 releases, and hold 2024 out until the relation and coefficients are fixed. No validation or holdout score enters coefficient fitting.
target_definition: Base-pretrained-model five-shot MMLU average accuracy in percentage points. Report protocols are similar but not identical, and benchmark contamination, data composition, tokenizer, architecture, and evaluation harness changes make this a narrow retrospective screen rather than a capability or RSI calibration.
compute_proxy_definition: Six times dense parameter count times pretraining-token count. This is a training-FLOP proxy, not audited end-to-end development compute; the Llama 3.1 token count is a published lower bound.
